Value.Abstract: Xabi Alonso has admitted Chelsea are low in confidence and struggling to hold on to results after a 3-2 defeat at Nottingham Forest on Friday condemned his side to a third straight Premier League loss. Value.Abstract: Liverpool manager Arne Slot has been handed a stark warning from Anfield legend Jamie Carragher, who believes the Dutchman has just one week left to salvage his position at the club. Value.Title: Kylian Mbappe's brother Ethan signs new Lille contract until 2029 just days after helping sink Bayern Munich in the Champions League
Value.Abstract: Kylian Mbappe's younger brother Ethan has signed a two-year contract extension with Lille, committing his future to the Ligue 1 side until 2029. Value.Abstract: ESPN’s Michael C. Wright says players around the league have started calling the San Antonio center “Mr. Morality” after his public stands on gambling partnerships and stat-padding put him at odds with some of the biggest names in basketball.
